title: Metheus subject index
description: A minimal pseudonymous index linking separately stored, versioned resources. It is not a complete person profile, identity record, consent grant, or permission to access linked data.

id.description: Unique pseudonymous identifier for this index revision.

subjectId.description: Pseudonymous subject reference; do not use a name, email, or external account identifier.

supersedes.description: ID of the immediately prior index revision for this subject.

steward.description: Declared stewardship metadata only; this does not verify identity, guardianship, or legal authority.

reference.description: Opaque local reference; do not embed direct identity details.

resourceRefs.description: Pointers only. A pointer does not imply consent, authorization, completeness, or permission to include that resource in a reading.

preferences.description: Optional display defaults only. These do not fill missing observation data or determine biological phase.

timeZone.description: IANA timezone used as a display default when a record-specific timezone is absent.
